did_you_know.title: Juneteenth National Independence Day, was signed into law by President Joe Biden…
did_you_know.text: Juneteenth National Independence Day, was signed into law by President Joe Biden, to become the first federal holiday established since Martin Luther King Jr. Day in 1983.

did_you_know.title: Juneteenth — The Last Enslaved People Are Freed
did_you_know.text: Union soldiers arrived in Galveston, Texas and announced that all enslaved people were free — two and a half years after the Emancipation Proclamation. June 19th became Juneteenth.
